text:
natalie: FYI hitting an onboarding parity bug: embedding dims mismatch between Node and Rust SDKs + rerank score type inconsistency. Quick notes and repro below.

natalie: Node returns 2048, Rust returns 2047 for the same input when using Batcher.smart() helper.

natalie: Node snippet:
```js
const r = await client.embeddings.create({model: 'rdw-embed-xxl', input: 'test'});
console.log(r.data[0].embedding.length) // 2048
```

natalie: Rust snippet:
```rust
let res = client.embeddings().create(...).await?;
println("{}", res.data[0].embedding.len()); // 2047
```

omar: suspiciously similar to the auth-retry body-rebuild issue. If the retry reconstructs from buffered chunks it might drop pad sentinel at the end. Rust's batcher pads inline; Node keeps pad metadata separate, so behavior diverges on retry.

natalie: Logs show: 
```
[2026-03-23T09:10:01Z] batcher: desired_len=2048 pad=1
[2026-03-23T09:10:01Z] send id=x1 auth=expired
[2026-03-23T09:10:01Z] retry: rebuild body -> pad metadata missing
[2026-03-23T09:10:02Z] response: embed_len=2047
```

jin: For rerank, a downstream client reported scores as strings in Rust JSON. We should normalise at sdk-core so all SDKs get numbers. I'll open two issues and add small CI checks in sampleapp.

ci-bot: Created issue #4990 sdk-rust: "preserve batch pad metadata across auth retry"
ci-bot: Created issue #4991 sdk-core: "rerank score normalization (string->float)"

omar: short-term workaround: set BATCHER_PAD_STRICT=1 or avoid batching. Long term: persist padCount on the batch context and use that when rebuilding requests during retry. Also add SDK_DEBUG_PAD env to surface operations.

natalie: thanks — added a tiny compare script to sampleapp CI to fail when dims differ across SDKs. Will follow up with traces in GH issues.

jin: I'll PR normalization into sdk-core and add tests. Omar — can you take the Rust patch?

omar: on it. will add unit tests and a debug flag.

natalie: great, ping here when PRs are up and i'll retest.
